summary: Distributed page integration has a sound queue-level dependency model and useful authority protections, but the current Local Steward executable is not yet a safe machine-enforced consumer of the actual worker-return substrate. Before any local integration lane is treated as integration-ready, the return-normalization/completeness boundary must be hardened and the Page Thread Bridge dependency must have a durable RETURN/DONE lineage.

findings.title: Deferred identity evidence can still enter the semantic candidate
findings.mechanism: buildLocalIntegrationCandidate records sourceIdentityProblems, but eligibleAtoms are collected from every applicable source before dispositions are applied. A source later classified DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is therefore not excluded from semantic_atoms merely because identity is insufficient.

minimal_counterexample.input: return_ref + run_id + semantic atom, but no content_sha
minimal_counterexample.current_semantic_effect: atom remains eligible unless separately blocked by protected authority/scope
minimal_counterexample.current_candidate_state_risk: CANDIDATE_DECISION_READY is possible because identity problems are not part of candidateState blocking conditions
minimal_counterexample.required_behavior: deferred identity evidence contributes zero decision atoms and keeps integration non-ready until exact identity evidence exists

findings.test_gap: The existing missing-identity test asserts the DEFERRED disposition and MISSING_CONTENT_SHA reason, but does not assert that the deferred source is excluded from semantic_atoms or that candidate_state is non-ready. The recovery test PASS therefore does not falsify this finding.

findings.title: The Local Steward does not natively consume the observed prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 schema
findings.mechanism: fallbackAtoms recognizes mission_result, result, summary.text, summary or statement. A real completed surface return inspected in this run uses result_summary plus material_advances/non_obvious_findings and has no semantic_atoms/atoms or recognized fallback field.
findings.consequence: A valid dependency return can normalize to zero semantic atoms and be dispositioned OUT_OF_SCOPE unless an external/manual adapter reshapes it. That adapter is not enforced by the steward helper, so local integration is not yet a closed machine contract.

findings.title: Queue dependency completeness is not bound into the Steward API
findings.mechanism: Each local integration opportunity requires seven surface returns plus Local Steward and Page Thread Bridge returns and says all dependency returns must be explicitly dispositioned. buildLocalIntegrationCandidate defaults required_return_refs to an empty list, so completeness only blocks when a caller manually supplies the full set.
findings.consequence: A caller can obtain CANDIDATE_DECISION_READY from a subset of returns while the queue contract requires a complete dependency set. This moves a safety invariant from machine enforcement into caller discipline.

findings.title: Surface-level normalization can erase concrete owner boundaries
findings.mechanism: Control Plan current-truth evidence proves that the swarm surface label joins two distinct concrete authorities: the standalone Plan de Acción page and the global Prometeo owner shell. The observed opportunity-return wrapper has a surface-level result_summary but no typed semantic atoms preserving that decomposition.
findings.consequence: A generic summary adapter that emits one control-plan/summary atom would be easier to consume but would lose the owner split the archaeology explicitly says must be preserved.

findings.title: Page Thread Bridge still lacked a durable RETURN at the final prewrite probe
findings.mechanism: The Page Thread Bridge recovery run was STARTED, while its opportunity-return path still returned 404 during this critic run.
findings.consequence: All four local integration lanes must remain dependency-blocked regardless of Local Steward recovery completion.

verified_strengths.finding: Protected authority self-promotion is explicitly rejected by the Local Steward candidate boundary and covered by tests.
Same-scope contradictions remain unresolved and do not use newest-wins.
The queue itself correctly encodes ALL_DEPENDENCIES_HAVE_RETURN for per-surface integration; the main defect is the unbound executable ingestion boundary, not the queue declaration.
The stale Local Steward opportunity was recovered append-only, exact published bytes were tested, and the recovery run is now DONE without rewriting the original attempt.

route_change.old_route: When queue dependencies have returns, invoke the Local Steward and let it produce a local integration candidate.
route_change.new_route: Keep queue activation evidence-gated, then require a deterministic integration preflight that derives required_return_refs directly from the claimed local-integration opportunity, normalizes each immutable dependency return into typed scope-preserving semantic atoms with exact return_ref/content_sha/run_id, rejects/deactivates all atoms from DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE sources, and refuses CANDIDATE_DECISION_READY unless every required dependency is present and dispositioned. Only then call the Local Steward candidate builder.
route_change.why: This removes caller discipline as the safety boundary and prevents a local steward from becoming a silent lossy/manual mini-integrator.

candidate_next_work.mission: Harden the Local Steward integration boundary so the actual immutable Prometeo opportunity-return schema is consumed deterministically, exact queue dependencies are machine-bound, deferred identity evidence cannot affect semantic candidates, and surface sub-owner scopes survive normalization.
acceptance_criteria: real prometeo.opportunity-return/v1 fixture with result_summary is normalized or explicitly rejected with a typed non-ready reason; never silently OUT_OF_SCOPE
a source missing content_sha contributes zero semantic atoms and cannot yield decision-ready state
required return refs are derived from the claimed local-integration opportunity and omission of any dependency is blocking
control-plan fixture preserves separate plan-page and global-control scopes rather than flattening them to one summary atom
existing authority/newest-wins/immutability tests continue to pass
exact-byte test receipt and immutable RETURN are persisted

dedup.notes: Do not reopen or overwrite the completed predecessor. Promote this only as a fresh append-only follow-up after allocator/Planner dedup against any newer proposals created after this snapshot.

boundary: This critic does not repair shared executable bytes, promote a proposal into the queue, activate blocked local integration, or make Current/Human Accepted/Served claims.
